chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Chapter 446: The Ghost King Beckons
chapter_meta_description: Han Li confronts a terrifying ghost in the mist. Allies waver, lore unfolds, and the legacy of the Void Heaven Palace is revealed. Every step is a choice.
og_title: RMJI Chapter 446 – The Ghost King Beckons
og_description: Han Li faces a near-Ghost King threat in the Ghost Mist. Zi Ling holds firm, but Ge Li chooses to retreat. The secrets of the Void Heaven Palace begin to surface.
twitter_description: In the Ghost Mist, one ally retreats while Han Li and Zi Ling push forward. The lore of the Void Heaven Palace is revealed—and a killer ghost is already fighting the black-robed man.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-tier spectral ruler in Chinese folklore; in xianxia, it denotes a ghost fiend so powerful it can challenge Core Formation cultivators.
A legendary floating jade palace that descends to the Chaotic Star Sea once every 300 years, filled with ancient treasures and guarded by three trial stages.
A rare spirit fruit believed to extend lifespan; often sought by aging cultivators who have given up on breakthrough.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ge Li choose to retreat?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He has no personal stake in the treasure; he came only for Longevity Fruits. For him, a peaceful death is better than eternal ghostly damnation.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Ghost King realm?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It designates a ghost so powerful it rivals a mid-stage Core Formation cultivator. Han Li’s warning is not hyperbole.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li bury the skeleton?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Part solidarity, part cold practicality. He hopes others might do the same for him, and he takes the treasures as a "burial fee."

cultural_notes_faq.q: How does the Void Heaven Palace open?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Every 300 years, it descends from the sky to a random, remote location in the Chaotic Star Sea.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What are the three trial stages?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The three major "gates" between the outer halls and the inner sanctum. Only Nascent Soul cultivators or the very lucky survive all three.
